cells.gaps: No source from the last three years says a safety-net programme's MIS exchanges data with a payment provider or the ID in use; the World Bank calls direct MIS-to-payment integration a plan. Nothing found on a shared registry or a link to the ID.
cells.note: In March 2024 the government was piloting safety-net payments through Telebirr in two regions, with World Bank support, so a link to a payment provider is piloted. Direct integration of the programme MIS with payment platforms is only planned, so not 3.
